items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: to New York I dashed up to (Bud Powell), I said, Bud, you're the end.

ctx.x: Oh it's terrible if the person gets ripped off and doesn't get a chance to work himself you know. I remember one night when I first came
to New York I dashed up to (Bud Powell), I said, Bud, you're the end. He said, 'yes? give me a job!' (LAUGHTER). That took care of me, I said, well......
When I first met Janis Joplin I sat in what was its Fillmore East, and heard her doing an exact copy of something that I had heard before. An exact copy.
